name: Vitasoy International Holdings Limited
summary: Vitasoy International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells food and beverages in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore. The company offers soy, almond, and oat products, as well as other plant milk and soya related products. It also provides yogurt, tea, juice, soymilk, water, and tofu. In addition, the company operates tuck shops and catering business. It sells its products through distributors and retailers. The company was incorporated in 1940 and is headquartered in Tuen Mun, Hong Kong.
